tools.name: bssb2b_list_volume_pricing_rules
tools.description: List quantity-break (volume) pricing rules for the store, with pagination, sorting and filters. Pass `ids` (max 100) to read specific rules. Returns rules with their quantity tiers and a pageInfo cursor. API: GET /api/v2/vp/rules.

tools.name: bssb2b_list_custom_pricing_rules
tools.description: List all custom (B2B) pricing rules of the store: discount type and value, priority, status, and the customers, tags, products and markets each rule applies to. API: POST /api/v1/rule/get-by-domain.

tools.name: bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rule
tools.description: Get one custom pricing rule by its numeric id. API: POST /api/v1/rule/get-by-id.

tools.name: bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rules_for_products
tools.description: Find which custom pricing rules apply to the given product ids or product tags. API: POST /api/v1/rule/get-rules-by-products.

tools.name: bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rules_for_customers
tools.description: Find which custom pricing rules apply to the given customer ids or customer tags. API: POST /api/v1/rule/get-rules-by-customers.

tools.name: bssb2b_search_products
tools.description: Search the store's products by text. Returns one page; pass the returned cursor (afterIndex) to fetch the next page. API: POST /api/v1/product/search.

tools.name: bssb2b_get_registration_form
tools.description: Get a wholesale registration form definition by its numeric id: fields, labels, types and whether each is required. API: GET /api/v1/rf/form/{id}.

tools.name: bssb2b_list_registrations
tools.description: List wholesale applicants filtered by status and submission date range. Use status pending to see the accounts waiting for approval. API: POST /api/v1/rf/wholesaler/filter.

tools.name: bssb2b_save_custom_pricing_rule
tools.description: Create a custom pricing rule, or update one when `rule.id` is set. Changes live B2B prices in the store. `rule` holds the rule fields (name, priority, status, apply_to, product_condition_type, product_ids, discount_type, discount_value, exc_product_variants, ...). API: POST /api/v1/rule/save.

tools.name: bssb2b_delete_custom_pricing_rules
tools.description: Delete one or more custom pricing rules by id. Deleted rules stop changing store prices at once. API: POST /api/v1/rule/mass-delete.

tools.name: bssb2b_set_registration_status
tools.description: Approve or reject wholesale applicants by email. Only accounts in PENDING status can change; others are not touched. Approval gives the account wholesale prices. API: POST /api/v1/rf/wholesaler/{approve|reject}.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bssb2b_list_custom_pricing_rules, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rule, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rules_for_products, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rules_for_customers, bssb2b_search_products, bssb2b_list_registrations · Public sink: bssb2b_list_custom_pricing_rules, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rule, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rules_for_products, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rules_for_customers, bssb2b_search_products, bssb2b_list_registrations, bssb2b_save_custom_pricing_rule, bssb2b_delete_custom_pricing_rules, bssb2b_set_registration_status · Destructive: bssb2b_delete_custom_pricing_rules.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bssb2b_list_custom_pricing_rules, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rule, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rules_for_products, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rules_for_customers, bssb2b_search_products, bssb2b_list_registrations · Public sink: bssb2b_list_custom_pricing_rules, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rule, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rules_for_products, bssb2b_get_custom_pricing_rules_for_customers, bssb2b_search_products, bssb2b_list_registrations, bssb2b_save_custom_pricing_rule, bssb2b_delete_custom_pricing_rules, bssb2b_set_registration_status · Destructive: bssb2b_delete_custom_pricing_rules

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
